scripts.dev:split: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && tsc --noEmit
scripts.postinstall: prisma generate --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma || echo 'Prisma client not generated yet — run: npm run db:generate -w backend'
